subject.title: feat(android): approve, reject, and remove device pairings from the phone

question: Should Android be allowed to remove its own active pairing, and if so, what local sign-out/unpair completion contract must the app guarantee?
rationale: This decision determines whether a privileged phone can intentionally invalidate its own gateway credential and is not safely resolved from the supplied diff summary alone.

options.title: Disallow active-device removal
options.body: Keep Remove unavailable for the current Android identity and require another paired administrator to remove it.

options.title: Add local unpair flow
options.body: Allow self-removal only through a dedicated flow that clears local credentials and truthfully handles the expected disconnect.

recommendation.title: Disallow active-device removal
recommendation.body: Keep Remove unavailable for the current Android identity and require another paired administrator to remove it.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed Android pairing flow and are assigned to this PR.
